chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Hafs, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
He makes up the salat (prayer) during whose time he regained consciousness.

key_terms.يَقْضِي: he makes up or performs in qaḍāʾ

ai.seo_question: Which salat (prayer) must an unconscious person make up after regaining consciousness?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who had been unconscious. It states that he must perform the make-up of the salat (prayer) whose time he lived to regain consciousness in.
